Field guide

Getting through tech with PassTech

Three ways to use the racer safety-equipment checker — by Frog Racing

PassTech checks your driver gear — helmet, balaclava, HANS/HNR, firesuit, gloves, shoes, undergarment, arm restraint — and your car gear — seat, belts/harness, window net, fuel cell, and rollover protection — against the published rules of 45 rulesets, spanning autocross, rally, road racing, hillclimb, endurance, HPDE, drag racing, and karting. This is the same guided tour built into the app — tap “How it works” any time to run it yourself, right down to picking a body, refining by class, opening the rulebook, and saving a gear set to My Gear.

Guided tour — captured live from the app’s own “How it works” walkthrough

1 One line, up front — what PassTech checks and how many rulesets it covers.
2 Option 1 — check the rules of a sanctioning body.
3 Option 2 — check whether your gear will pass tech.
4 Option 3 — see where your gear can race.
5 My Gear — your personal space to save named gear sets, right from the main menu.
6 By default, PassTech checks driver, car, and rollover-protection safety gear all at once — uncheck any of the three to focus on just the others.
7 Pick a body and discipline — SCCA Solo, for example.
8 Refine by class — SCCA Solo’s Modified (AM / BM / CM / DM / EM / FM).
9 Click through to the official rulebook for that body and class.
10 The Equipment Summary box — everything at a glance, with a shortcut straight to any item.
1

Check the rules

No gear entry needed. Pick a sanctioning body and browse exactly what it requires, what it accepts, and any conditions — a reference copy of the rulebook, not a check against your own equipment.

  1. From the main menu, choose “Check the rules”
  2. Toggle Driver Safety Gear / Car Safety Gear / Rollover Protection at the top to focus on just the sections you care about — all three are on by default.
  3. Pick a body and discipline from the dropdown, e.g. SCCA Time Trial — PHA.
  4. Each category shows its requirement, accepted certifications, and any conditions — straight from the rulebook.
  5. Standards the body doesn’t list are collapsed under a red “Not accepted” panel, so gaps in a rulebook are easy to spot.

PHA — Helmet

Full-face required Required

Accepted: Snell SA2015/2020/2025, SFI 31.1A, SFI 31.2A

2

Will my equipment pass tech?

Enter what you actually have, checked against one body’s rules. Each item resolves independently, and an overall PassTech verdict sits at the top — green, yellow, or red.

  1. Choose “Will my equipment pass tech?” and pick a body.
  2. Expand each item and fill in what you have — a category with nothing entered yet shows a No data tag until you do.
  3. Pick the certification standard printed on the tag, or use Scan tag photo to read it from a picture.
  4. The verdict banner updates live: red for a real violation, yellow when only an optional/conditional item is unresolved, green once everything required checks out.
  5. Check Hide Not Required Gear at the top to collapse the list down to just what this body actually requires or conditionally requires — handy once you know which items you’re bringing and just want the short list.

Verdict states

Fail — Helmet: required, not entered.
Conditional — Shoes: no cert needed, not specified.
Pass — everything required is satisfied.
3

Where can my equipment race?

Enter your gear once, and PassTech checks it against every ruleset it knows — useful if you run with more than one club or series. Results sort into three buckets, each grouped by discipline.

  1. Choose “Where can my equipment race?” and enter your gear (no body to pick — it checks all of them).
  2. Only check the equipment I have, up next to Rollover protection, drops any category with nothing entered from the results instead of failing it outright — the form below hides those empty categories too, with a reminder to uncheck it when you want to add more.
  3. Add a codriver’s gear with the Add codriver gear toggle — it only affects rally bodies that require one.
  4. The new Filter box lets you pick just the disciplines you race — uncheck any of the ten and every result below, the equipment summary counts, and the PDF export all narrow to match.
  5. Bodies you fully satisfy land in Eligible.
  6. Eligible under condition means everything required is fine, but an optional item (e.g. an arm restraint that only applies to open cars) is still unresolved.
  7. Does not meet the requirements covers anything missing or rejected outright.

Results, grouped by discipline

Ice Racing
Eligible under condition — BMW CCA Ice Autocross
Autocross
Does not meet the requirements — SCCA Solo, BMW CCA Autocross
4

My Gear

Your personal space to save named gear sets, so you don’t have to re-enter everything every time you check a body or run the eligibility scan again.

  1. From the main menu, click My Gear, then + New gear set and give it a name — a car, a driver, whatever tells your sets apart.
  2. Fill it in the same way as Option 2 or 3: expand a category, pick the certification, and use Scan tag photo or the photo-upload button on any item to snap the tag instead of typing it — PassTech reads the standard and any printed dates straight off the photo.
  3. Check Add codriver gear to add a second set of driver items for rally — or pull in a codriver’s own gear directly with Import codriver gear set from file, using the file they exported from their own PassTech.
  4. From the list, Export gear set saves the set as a file or shares it by email — the matching Import button on the main My Gear screen reads that file straight back in, on any device.
  5. Once a set is filled in, load it straight into Will my equipment pass tech? or Where can my equipment race? from either the list or the editor — no re-entering.

Export gear set

📄 Save as file
📧 Email

Nothing ever leaves your browser except a file you explicitly export — there’s no account and no server copy.

Also worth knowing

📷 Scan instead of typing

On any item, use Scan tag photo to snap the certification tag — it reads the standard and any printed dates, and flags photos that look like the wrong kind of tag.

⚠️ Expiration warnings

An accepted certification expiring within the current calendar year shows a warning with the exact date, right next to that item’s result.

📲 Works offline

From the main menu, install PassTech to your home screen or desktop — it keeps working at the track with no signal.

🎯 Refine by class

When a body defines its own competitor classes — AMEC’s Street Legal vs. Super Modified, SCCA Solo’s Street vs. Modified, an SCCA GCR class exemption — a Refine by class dropdown appears under the body picker. Pick yours and the rules sharpen to exactly your class; leave it on “All classes” for the general picture.

🧮 Equipment summary

The box above the item list shows everything at a glance — one line per requirement level in Options 1–2, or a numbered icon per category in Option 3 (see Station 3). Click any icon or line to jump straight to that item further down the page.

PassTech is a pre-screening tool, not a certification — the tech inspector still makes the final call. passtech.frogracing.us
